body:
Answer: Nursing Ausbildung is one of the most requested Germany pathways from Pakistan. It needs a real training contract, stronger German than many other trades, and careful credential checks. There is no honest “guaranteed nursing visa” product.

What files usually include

  • Ausbildung contract in nursing
  • German certificates at the required level
  • Academics + translations
  • Health/insurance documents as listed
  • National visa set via mission/VFS

Red flags

  • Contracts that cannot be verified
  • “No German needed for nursing” claims
  • Upfront fees to unknown overseas agents only

Evidence standard before you spend

For anything related to nursing, ausbildung, germany, keep proofs that a third party can verify: offers on letterhead, bank PDFs with history, attestation receipts, and language results that match the program. Screenshots without context are not a file. If a seller asks you to hide a refusal, change the topic — that is not how SK Immigration works.

  • Offer/contract names match the passport spelling
  • Language rule is printed (IELTS score, MOI, German level, etc.)
  • Funds story matches 3–6 months of statements where missions care about history
  • Attestation order is destination-correct (Apostille vs MOFA paths are not toys)
  • Official mission or university pages were opened the same week you pay

Mistakes we see on “nursing ausbildung germany” files

  • Believing Ausbildung is available with zero German for nursing/tech roles
  • Paying cash to an unverifiable “German employer agent”
  • Submitting a degree-style SOP for a vocational contract
  • Ignoring recognition/language timelines until the flight week
